title: filix-mas villosa
intro: Filix-mas villosa, commonly known as the hairy fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The hairy fern is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Filix-mas villosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
